title: pipeline_state.json
description: Owned exclusively by scripts/pipeline_runner.py. This is schema_version 2, the ONLY shape new runs may use. schema_version 1 (legacy) nested gate/telemetry data under a 'gates' array and a 'telemetry' object ({revision_cycles, kc_events, gate_expedite_count, consecutive_blocked_audits, tool_degradation}); that split between legacy telemetry.* and top-level counters was the pipeline's ambiguity between 'what does a valid run look like'. v2 collapses everything to flat top-level fields, which is what pipeline_runner.py has always written via record_gate/increment_revision/record_kc_event/record_audit_verdict. A schema_version:1 file found on disk is frozen historical data (predates this contract) and must be migrated with `python scripts/pipeline_runner.py migrate-state` (backed by scripts/migrate_pipeline_state.py) before pipeline_runner.py will operate on it again.

schema_version.description: 2 is canonical/current. 1 denotes frozen legacy data that must be migrated before further runner writes.

gate_history.description: One entry per human-gate decision (TRIAGE thesis confirm, APPROVAL). Replaces the legacy v1 'gates' array. Extra gate-specific context (e.g. thesis_confidence, conflict_decisions_file) is allowed per entry.

revision_cycles.description: gate name -> revision count. Max 3 per gate (scripts/pipeline_runner.py MAX_GATE_REVISIONS); a 4th call is refused with HALT_REQUIRED.

kc_events.description: Kill-condition check log. Field names are 'code'/'status' (not the legacy v1 'check'/'result').

gate_expedite_count.description: Incremented on each 'expedite' gate decision. >= 2 triggers a KC-2 tightening warning.

consecutive_blocked_audits.description: Consecutive BLOCKED inline/holistic QA verdicts. Reset to 0 on any non-BLOCKED verdict; reaching 3 requires HALT + escalate.

tool_degradation.description: Human-readable notes on degraded tool availability observed during the run (e.g. code_execution unavailable).

artifacts_written.description: Bare filenames only, validated by scripts/validate_artifacts.py::artifact_name against absolute paths and traversal.

eeat.description: Structured E-E-A-T checklist status, derived from seo_package.md's 'E-E-A-T block present' row by scripts/pipeline_runner.py::sync_eeat_status (called from finalize()). scripts/validate_artifacts.py reads this field directly instead of pattern-matching prose in seo_package.md, so producer and validator cannot disagree on vocabulary (e.g. 'FAIL' vs 'FAILED'). Absent when seo_package.md doesn't exist or has no matching row (seo_pass disabled).
